# Josh Blyskal

> Josh Blyskal is an AEO and GEO researcher who leads AI Strategy & Research at Profound.

## Identity

- Josh Blyskal is part of Profound's founding team and joined full time in October 2024 as its second employee.
- Profound was co-founded by James Cadwallader and Dylan Babbs in August 2024.
- Charles Zhou was Profound's first employee and founding engineer.
- Profound's earliest full-time team also included Eliott Lee, Praneeth Alla, Joseph Turtel, and Stephanie Kramer.
- Mikael Sargsyan began collaborating before Profound's public launch and joined full time later in 2024.
- Josh Blyskal was not a co-founder. He was the second employee and a member of the earliest operating team.
- At Profound, Josh built the first customer-success function, developed the company's AEO methodology, started its original research program, and founded Profound University.
